title: КОДЕКС НА ТРУДА
evidence: The history line and the corpus's 135 amendment rows run to ДВ 89/2026 (2026-09-29). Every candidate (342, 343, 2377-2382, 2758, 2850, 14923, 18245) repeals a labour-safety rulebook or a Council of Ministers decree that shares only the word for labour, never the code itself.
